[[Lissah the Packleader]] is the alpha leader of a pack of [[Stonewolf|Stonewolves]] in the [[Bjora Marches]]. Although a leader of [[fleshy]] [[stonewolf|stonewolves]], this boss is a non-fleshy [[elemental]], similar to the [[Shard Wolf]].

== Locations ==
* [[Far Shiverpeaks]]
** {{NPC location|Bjora Marches}} (within [[Gursteig's Cavern]])

* {{Skill icon|Penetrating Blow}}
* {{Skill icon|Power Attack}}

* [[Lissah's Edge]] ([[unique]])

== Notes ==
* In the German language version they are called "Lissah der Rudelführer" which would indicate they are male (otherwise it would be "Lissah die Rudelführerin").
